presentation.name: Write a DevOps ticket that can be acted on without a call
presentation.summary: Drafts a change, access or fault ticket for the DevOps team with the exact workload, environment and target, the evidence, the ask and how the result is verified.
benefits: Spots the parts of a change that need DevOps: new hosts, secrets, permissions, resource limits and deployables
Names the environment, workload, target and time exactly, so the right thing gets tested
States a change with its current and new values, risk, rollback and verification
Separates observation, what was ruled out, hypothesis and ask in a fault report, with a reproduction that matches the failure
Keeps credentials and personal data out of the ticket and its attachments
